name: next-js-15-5-9-webpackerror-not-a-constructor
hook: Next.js 15.5.9 webpack 5.98.0 removed WebpackError from compiled bundle
body: Next.js 15.5.9 bundles webpack 5.98.0 which removed WebpackError from `next/dist/compiled/webpack/webpack`. The minify-webpack-plugin uses `new _webpack.WebpackError(...)` but _webpack.WebpackError is undefined. Fix: patch the minify-webpack-plugin source to fall back to Error when WebpackError is unavailable. Created scripts/patch-next-minify-webpack.cjs that is run via prebuild script in package.json.
why: This is a regression in Next.js 15.5.9's bundled webpack. The minify-webpack-plugin's buildError function cannot construct a WebpackError, causing the build to fail. The fix is to patch the plugin to use Error as a fallback.

name: prebuild-script-patches-node-modules
hook: Use prebuild script to patch node_modules files that need fixing after every install
body: When a bug in a third-party package (like Next.js) needs to be fixed, and the package is not patched via patch-package, use a prebuild script to patch the file directly. The script uses find to locate the installed file, checks for a marker to avoid double-patching, and applies the fix. This ensures the patch is applied on every build regardless of how node_modules was populated.
why: The patched file in node_modules/.pnpm would be reset on every pnpm install. Running the patch as a prebuild script ensures it's applied before every build, regardless of whether node_modules came from cache or fresh install.
